title: Sustainable base oils from non-edible fats: performance of esterified, epoxidized, and hydroxylated brown grease
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50036-50044
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07581E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ykok B. Ksor, Ashlyn D. Smith, Rhett C. Smith
Brown grease (BG), a high free-fatty-acid rendering coproduct, was upgraded to lubricant base stocks via one of four single-step functionalization methods: ethyl esterification, methyl esterification, epoxidation, or hydroxylation.
